Mr. Freeze Heart of Ice Real Elite Masterline collectible statue unveiled by Prime 1 Studio

October 4, 2026 by Amie Cranswick

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:14
Instaread

Prime 1 Studio has unveiled the deluxe 1:3 scale Mr. Freeze Heart of Ice Real Elite Masterline diorama which depicts the chilling supervillain with his wife Nora in her cryogenic chamber, based on a design by comic book artist Carlos D’Anda and inspired by the classic Batman: The Animated Series retelling of the rogue’s origin. Limited to 350 units, the DC collectible is available to pre-order now, priced at $3,199; take a look here…

Madness, insecurity, lust for control, jealousy—dark impulses swirl through Gotham City. From this city steeped in darkness, Mr. Freeze, a man bound by love, joins the Real Elite Masterline.

Having lost the warmth of the life he once knew, this villain of ice turns his freezing power on others in pursuit of revenge. The tragic character defined by the 1990s Batman animated series and carried into comics and film is captured here in a moment of stillness. Through Carlos D’Anda’s concept and the craftsmanship of the Real Elite Masterline, this subzero scene is realized at 1/3 scale.

A face seen through the dome, marked by obsession and pain. A rugged freeze suit with the utilitarian presence of industrial machinery. His quiet stance is grounded in realism. From piping that suggests circulating coolant to mechanisms that augment his legs, every component feels built with a purpose. The goggles and Freeze Gun feature LED illumination, their stark mechanical glow adding emotional depth.

His wife Nora, sleeping beneath the blue light, is rendered in precise detail down to the faintest signs of life. The Cryogenic Chamber features a motif reminiscent of a goddess, lending it a sacred atmosphere.

The Deluxe Version includes two additional heads with distinct designs, along with a bare right hand and Head Stands for a range of display options. A further head is also included as a bonus part, offering even more customization options.

Specifications:

    • Mr. Freeze Themed Base
    • Three (3) Swappable Heads
    • Two (2) Swappable Right Hands (Freeze Gun, Bare Hand)
    • Two (2) Head Stands
    • LED Illumination (Goggles, Freeze Gun, Cryogenic Freezing Chamber)
    • One (1) Swappable Head [BONUS PART]
    • One (1) Head Stand [BONUS PART]

 

Originally published October 4, 2026. Updated October 6, 2026.
